parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a magnetic field.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: State the direction of the magnetic field.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the speed of the particle is not affected by the magnetic field.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Show that the diameter $d$ of the semi-circular path is given by the expression
$$d = \frac{2mv}{Bq}.$$

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Use the expression in (b)(iii) to show that the time $T_{F}$ spent in the field by the particle is independent of its speed $v$.
